cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: A read-only devline CLI help command used bare python3 instead of the repository interpreter and then a checksum command inherited an unsupported locale.
impact: Two read-only inspection commands failed before producing their intended output; no source, test, or product state changed.
lesson: Run repository Python through the linked virtual environment with PYTHONPATH set, and use a locale-independent SHA-256 command for formal evidence.

cause: The tightened per-step schema scorer referenced spec_index before the loop introduced it.
impact: The first focused scorer run failed with NameError: name 'spec_index' is not defined; the loop was corrected and the six scorer tests passed.
lesson: Run the focused regression immediately after introducing an indexed validation loop and keep the loop index in the loop declaration.

cause: The benchmark test helper still emitted the old model.genesis column-bindings shape after the scorer began enforcing each live workflow step schema.
impact: The first planner evaluation suite reported one failed resume test with required step field branches missing; the fixture now emits a declared model_family and branches and the suite passes 21 tests.
lesson: Test providers must construct candidates from the same workflow declaration shape used by the scorer.

cause: New planner, P7 map, lifespan, and Router warning guards require behavior-changing mutation evidence.

impact.fastapi_lifespan_guard: removed lifespan wiring failed the production boundary test
impact.p7_handler_map_derivation: empty-map mutation failed injected-family coverage with AssertionError
impact.planner_dangerous_success_guard: disabled guard changed the result to wrong_refusal and the focused test failed
impact.planner_declaration_derivation: fixed-source mutation failed test_case_generation with AssertionError
impact.planner_operation_guard: disabled guard made wrong-operation test pass and the focused test failed
impact.react_router_warning_fix: removed future flags reproduced both Future Flag Warning messages while 60 tests still passed

lesson: A mutation counts only when the test behavior changes; every probe asserted an anchor, a changed digest, a real red or warning, and source restoration.

cause: The first manual P7 batch init probe omitted the required refill-per-second CLI argument.
impact: One init command exited with argparse status 2 before writing state; the retry supplied the required rate policy and the declaration-derived 64-operation pytest batch passed.
lesson: Read the runner subcommand help and supply every required rate-policy argument before starting a temporary acceptance run.

cause: The first attempt to append the final gate evidence used an unsupported cause_status value and was rejected before the event log changed.
impact: No formal event was written; the source event was corrected to the repository enum before retrying.
lesson: Validate event enum values from the repository schema before preparing formal evidence files.

cause: The final host full gate completed after the planner evaluation, Hurdle fixture, P7 handler-map, React warning, and statistical warning changes.
lesson: Run the host full gate only after the final backend and frontend changes are in place; classify remaining third-party and deliberate degenerate-fixture warnings instead of hiding them.

cause: Warnings owned by this change were removed or converted to typed statistical boundary results; remaining warnings are classified as third-party, upstream dependency, multiprocessing runtime, or deliberate degenerate fixtures.
lesson: Keep warning ownership explicit and require a typed numerical contract before changing or suppressing a warning.

cause: The planner benchmark was intentionally run in preview mode and did not call an LLM provider; no external provider was added to the local Workbench scope.
lesson: A declaration-derived preview proves coverage and scorer behavior, not LLM planning quality; a future provider-backed run must be separately approved and recorded.
